spec.scene: A small patch of snowy sidewalk fills the foreground, boot prints pressed into the fresh white. At the center a black iron lamp post glows soft amber, snow resting on its cap, and beside it a white mug of hot chocolate with whipped cream stands a little larger than life. To the left a long wooden study desk with a glowing green banker's lamp, and at the back edge a tall arched library window slice glowing warm behind frosted glass. A small figure in a red beanie stands near the lamp, and snow rests on every surface.
spec.title: Midnight Walk After Orgo
spec.caption: Eleven hours of reactions, then the quietest snowy walk home with Jake's cocoa.
